newsitem.title: JAPAN: Argentina says may launch samurai bonds on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Argentina says may launch samurai bonds on Friday.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said on Thursday that Argentina hopes to launch samurai bonds as early as Friday, a Japaneses Finance Ministry official told reporters.

Fernandez is visiting Japan to oversee Argentina's first samurai bond issue in Japan. The scale of the offer is yet to be decided, the MOF official quoted Fernandez as telling Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka.
Underwriting sources have said Argentina may launch two tranches of samurai bonds with maturities of six and 10 years on Thursday, depending on market conditions.
The sources said the issues will be lead-managed by Nikko Securities.
Fernandez told Mitsuzuka this would not be Argentina's last samurai bond issue and that he hoped to launch another one if there was a chance to do so, the official said.
